summary.text: Brad Barrett is a Republican member of the Indiana House representing District 56, which covers Wayne County and portions of Henry County, serving since 2018.
The caucus page describes him as a retired general surgeon who served Wayne County for 25 years.

paragraphs.text: Barrett graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a degree in pre-professional studies and earned an M.D. from The Ohio State University College of Medicine.
The page says he is a former president of General Surgeons, Inc. and recently served as president of the Indiana Chapter of the American College of Surgeons.
Barrett serves on the boards of the Reid Health Foundation and the Boys and Girls Club of Wayne County.
He and his wife, Mary Ann, live in Richmond and have two children.
